title.zh: EQ 各频段的增益/频率/Q 也能画包络了
title.en: An EQ band's gain, frequency and Q can now be drawn as envelopes

highlights.zh: 自动化补齐 insert 链：低/中/高各频段的 gainDb、hz、q 共九项都能画包络，量程与面板滑杆同源（±18 dB、20–18000 Hz、Q 0.2–12）。
highlights.en: Automation now covers the insert chain: gainDb, hz and q for each of the three EQ bands — nine fields — on the same ranges the panel's sliders use (±18 dB, 20–18000 Hz, Q 0.2–12).

highlights.zh: 曲线画在已旁通的频段上会自动打开该频段（否则听不到，会让人以为功能坏了）；调度直接写 AudioParam，不会每步重建路由。
highlights.en: A curve drawn on a bypassed band switches that band on — otherwise it would be inaudible and read as broken. The value is scheduled straight at the AudioParam, so routing is not rebuilt on every step.
